goal: Describe each industry equal-weight price position and relative strength as of T-1, then summarize same-day T industry return, excess, and Top100 lift by state.
industry_level: Start each uninterrupted shared-calendar segment at 100 and compound that date's valid-pool cross-sectional equal-weight industry mean return. Any missing date or N=0 breaks the segment; the next valid date restarts at 100; never forward-fill.
inference: Descriptive only; no stability or statistical significance PASS.
main_summary: industry x 3 position buckets x 2 RS20 buckets, then stratified by T-1 lag_market; UNKNOWN buckets retained separately for coverage.

market_linkage.same_day: Per-industry Spearman rho between the same-day industry mean and same-day bound 000300 close-to-close return, with paired-day count.
market_linkage.up_nonup: On paired dates, report equal-date industry mean/excess and mean daily Top100 lift for index return > 0 (UP) and <= 0 (NONUP).

outcome_fields: same-day industry excess over valid-pool mean
pass_signal: T states use only data dated before T
252-window state stays UNKNOWN when support is insufficient
missing dates/N=0 break the level chain
main and RS60 summaries preserve support and UNKNOWN cells
latest snapshot labels its close-inclusive timing

position_buckets.UNKNOWN: fewer than 252 contiguous valid prior levels

position_window_rule: For outcome date T, rank the close level at T-1 within exactly 252 contiguous valid industry levels ending at T-1.
rs60_summary: Independent RS60 sensitivity by industry and lag_market; no 3 x 2 position cross.
rs_definition: Difference between compounded industry equal-weight and valid-pool equal-weight returns over exactly the named consecutive sessions ending T-1; missing component return makes state UNKNOWN.
